name: swift-plugin
description: Plain Swift backend stack provider for the SDLC marketplace (priority=100). Detects Package.swift and registers a swift-architect agent (Sonnet/medium) as the development-phase backend implementer for SwiftPM libraries, command-line tools (swift-argument-parser) and HTTP servers (Vapor, Hummingbird). Xcode app projects are claimed by apple-plugin (priority 300, backend + frontend), so swift-plugin stays inactive there. Reuses shared skills from swift-foundation (swift-conventions, swift-tooling, swift-testing).
